name: Spellbound: The Magic Within
source:
Jump into a world of Magic, Witchcraft and Mystery as the town of Witcherley's newest resident. After discovering you have an abundance of magical energy your family send you to learn how to harness that power with an old family friend. You swiftly find yourself relocating to the charming village of Witcherley where you will interact with a host of unusual characters. Choose from multiple schools of magic, bond with your tutor, and maybe even save the world.

Your choices will impact the way characters interact with you, how your magic develops and ultimately the ending you receive.

Where will your powers take you? Who can be trusted in this village? And what's going on in the forest?

The choices are yours but are you ready for the consequences. Will you be strong enough when the time comes?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1500280/Spellbound__The_Magic_Within/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
成为威彻利小镇的新居民，踏入一个充满魔法、巫术与谜团的世界。家人发现你体内蕴藏着充沛的魔力后，便送你到一位世交那里，学习如何驾驭这份力量。很快，你就搬进了风景迷人的威彻利村，与形形色色的奇人相遇。选择不同的魔法流派，与导师建立感情，甚至可能拯救世界。

你的选择会影响角色们对你的态度、魔法的成长方向，以及最终迎来的结局。

你的力量会将你带向何方？村里有谁值得信任？森林里又发生了什么？

选择权在你手中，但你准备好承担后果了吗？当那一刻来临时，你会足够强大吗？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1500280/Spellbound__The_Magic_Within/]Steam[/url]]
